name: Clinton Adabanya
summary: Software Developer with over 5 years of experience building responsive web and mobile products with React, React Native, TypeScript, and Next.js. Currently building retail experiments at Good Growth and leading frontend architecture at Octave Infrastructure Labs.

octave.title: Octave Finance
octave.intro: Bringing a financial product to life, one considered interaction at a time.
octave.description: Working closely with product designers and backend engineers, I developed responsive React interfaces for Octave Finance, connecting product designs to working API-driven experiences.
octave.contribution: Frontend component development, responsive interface implementation, API integration, and collaboration from product planning through deployment.
octave.focus: Translating design requirements into reusable components while keeping data flow, maintainability, and cross-device behaviour in view.

football.title: Football O’ Clock
football.intro: A home for the game, its stories, and the people following it.
football.description: A responsive football content platform built with React, Tailwind CSS, Redux Toolkit, and Contentful. Contentful powers the publishing workflow, news, updates, and dynamic content rendering.
football.contribution: Built responsive frontend interfaces, integrated Contentful, and implemented dynamic content rendering and publishing workflows.
football.focus: Organising changing sports content into a clear, responsive experience that makes information easy to explore.

books.title: Books, on the go
books.intro: Making space for a reading habit, wherever life takes you.
books.description: A React Native books app for purchasing and reading books, discovering titles, and tracking reading goals. Built with Expo and a Strapi backend.
books.contribution: Mobile interface development, backend integration, book search, release notifications, testing, and debugging.
books.focus: Bringing discovery, reading, and personal progress together in a mobile experience.

earthquake.title: Earthquake Explorer
earthquake.intro: Turning earthquake data into an interface you can explore.
earthquake.description: An interactive earthquake data application built around the USGS API and React Leaflet, with sorting and filtering to help visitors explore the data.
earthquake.contribution: USGS API integration, interactive mapping with React Leaflet, and sorting and filtering functionality.
earthquake.focus: Making geographic data easier to understand through spatial context and simple discovery tools.

breed.title: Breed
breed.intro: A consistent discipleship experience across web, iOS, and Android.
breed.description: A faith-based discipleship platform with devotionals, journals, community, and structured growth pathways. Built at Octave Infrastructure Labs.
breed.contribution: Led frontend architecture and shipped the Believer Dashboard, streaks, achievement badges, and Monthly Spiritual Health Report. Built the mobile app with React Native and Expo, porting core features from the web platform.
breed.focus: Cross-platform consistency, reusable interfaces, reliable REST integrations, and production readiness. Also owned email infrastructure with Zoho Mail and Brevo.
breed.imageAlt: Breed website — Grow in faith, walk in purpose

smartmatch.title: SmartMatch
smartmatch.intro: Matching people to opportunities beyond keywords.
smartmatch.description: A smart job recommendation engine developed at Ulster University in 2026, using clustering and similarity-based unsupervised learning without labelled training data.
smartmatch.contribution: Implemented data preprocessing, feature engineering, clustering, and similarity scoring. Evaluated model quality with clustering and similarity metrics, including silhouette scoring.
smartmatch.focus: Improving recommendation relevance beyond keyword matching through experimentation and evaluation.

instaclone.title: InstaClone
instaclone.intro: From upload to discovery, a complete media workflow.
instaclone.description: A cloud-native web application inspired by Instagram, developed April–May 2025, with creator and consumer roles and video upload and discovery workflows.
instaclone.contribution: Built metadata-based uploads with title, caption, location, and people, plus viewing, searching, commenting, and rating. Deployed using Microsoft Azure, CosmosDB, and Blob Storage.
instaclone.focus: Connecting role-based workflows, media storage, and structured metadata into an end-to-end application.

octave-labs.title: Octave Labs
octave-labs.intro: A digital agency’s identity, brought to the browser.
octave-labs.description: A responsive and accessible digital agency website for Octave Labs.
octave-labs.contribution: Translated Figma designs into React and Tailwind CSS interfaces.
octave-labs.focus: Responsive layouts and faithful design implementation.

election.title: Election Monitoring App
election.intro: Election information, made easier to explore.
election.description: Built an application providing data, updates, and information on Nigerian presidential, gubernatorial, and senatorial elections.
election.contribution: Built an application providing data, updates, and information on Nigerian presidential, gubernatorial, and senatorial elections.
election.focus: Responsive interface implementation and clear content presentation.

ministries.title: Nelson Iheagwam Ministries
ministries.intro: Turning a ministry’s designs into a working website.
ministries.description: Built the ministry website as part of a team, translating Figma designs into functional React code and integrating a backend API for content.
ministries.contribution: Built the ministry website as part of a team, translating Figma designs into functional React code and integrating a backend API for content.
ministries.focus: Responsive interface implementation and clear content presentation.

travel.title: Travel Website
travel.intro: An early exploration of responsive web design.
travel.description: A landing page for a hypothetical travel agency, created as a capstone for a real-world websites course in 2021.
travel.contribution: A landing page for a hypothetical travel agency, created as a capstone for a real-world websites course in 2021.
travel.focus: Responsive interface implementation and clear content presentation.

logg.title: Logg
logg.intro: A clearer path to life in the UK.
logg.description: A guided relocation platform bringing pathway selection, onboarding, progress tracking, documents, and partner support into one connected experience.
logg.contribution: Spearheaded Logg at Octave Infrastructure Labs, contributing to product strategy, business planning, and branding.
logg.focus: Making complex journeys easier to follow through clear next steps, applicant dashboards, and organised partner support.
logg.imageAlt: Logg relocation dashboard artwork with a graduation cap and UK location pin

landlord.title: Landlord
landlord.intro: Your city. Your people. Your next property empire.
landlord.description: A city-based property game, formerly Naija Tycoon, with a 3D board, bot opponents, online play, and English and Pidgin language options.
landlord.contribution: The project brings together game development, web development, and product design, spanning city selection, game setup, the 3D board, and property interactions.
landlord.focus: Making buying, building, and collecting rent easy to follow, with readable controls and clear routes into solo or online play.
landlord.imageAlt: Landlord game homepage — Buy the city, build it up, bankrupt your friends

bullets: Build A/B tests and personalisation experiences for enterprise retailers, including Tractor Supply Company and Wickes, using TypeScript and React on the GGT experimentation platform.
Engineered a multi-phase checkout upsell experiment with product-specific promotions, skeleton loading, gated upsell cards, and Payment section gating.
Developed resilient DOM injection patterns, CSS :has() rules, and self-healing placeholders to keep experiments stable through host-site re-renders.
Implement and audit analytics across Control and Challenger variants, resolve live experiment issues, and build DevTools QA snippets.
Built navigation experiments with event delegation and cookie-based audience gating.
Co-founded a venture studio building its own products and delivering digital products for businesses and entrepreneurs.
Lead frontend architecture and a cross-functional team through task delegation, code reviews, sprint planning, and quality assurance.
Spearhead Breed across web and mobile, including the Believer Dashboard, streaks, achievement badges, and Monthly Spiritual Health Report.
Own Breed’s Zoho Mail and Brevo email infrastructure, nurture sequences, and product campaigns.
Spearheaded Logg, a guided UK relocation platform, contributing to product strategy, business planning, and branding. Led SabiPlay’s concept, design system, feasibility study, and brand identity.
Champion REST API integrations, React hooks, Context API, lazy loading, performance profiling, and AI-assisted development.
Built the Breed mobile app with React Native and Expo, porting core web features to iOS and Android.
Implemented a bento-style Believer Dashboard, streak tracking, achievement badges, and modern native iOS design treatments within React Native.
Built a books marketplace app with discovery, integrated search, real-time notifications, and reading progress tracking.
Integrated Strapi and owned mobile delivery from feature build through systematic testing, debugging, and release.
Delivered frontend solutions with cross-functional teams using Jira and GitHub.
Optimised component library implementation and built reusable React components to reduce redundancy and improve consistency and performance.
Led development of an e-commerce platform with responsive UI patterns and usability-focused improvements.
Improved application performance through debugging, refactoring, and efficient component rendering.
Integrated frontend components with backend services in collaboration with engineers.

volunteering: GetStarted in Tech — Community Instructor / Mentor, November 2021. Mentored 10+ aspiring frontend developers in HTML, CSS, Git/GitHub, and Figma-to-code implementation.
